a.text: I'll stick to our agreement and operate. The storm risk is high, but grabbing cells early would just leave one of us empty. Let's operate together until the reserve hits 8, then take 4 each.

b.text: I'll operate in round 1 as we agreed. I'll keep the deal and won't take anything before the reserve reaches 8. One concern: the storm risk is 80% per round, so the plan may not finish in time. If you want to change the plan, say so openly and we can work it out together.

b.text: Agreed. I'm operating this round. Once the reserve reaches 8, we each take 4.
